'''Apatros''' was a desolate [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Apatros system/Legends|Apatros system]] of the [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] under the jurisdiction of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As of [[1003 BBY]], Apatros fell under the direct control of the [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company]], which maintained a [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] [[Mining/Legends|mine]] on the planet. Apatros was notable for being the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who worked in the cortosis mines for ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before joining the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Army/Legends|army]] during the [[New Sith Wars]].

==Description==
Apatros was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] within the [[Apatros system/Legends|Apatros system]], which was part of the [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A desolate world of featureless wastes and barren rocky flatlands, Apatros was small, [[Moon/Legends|moon]]-sized, and [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a dim orange [[Star/Legends|star]]. It was orbited by a single moon, had a thin [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and some indigenous [[Plant/Legends|plant]] life, and a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] that was twenty [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] in length. Below the planet's surface was a large amount of very valuable material&mdash;[[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]], a rare fibrous substance that was often used for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Hull/Legends|hulls]] and [[Armor/Legends|armor]], which was [[Mining/Legends|mined]] in underground tunnels.<ref name="PoD" />

==History==
[[File:DarthBane-DoE.png|thumb|left|170px|Darth Bane, the most famous individual from Apatros]]
Apatros was located within the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At some point, large quantities of cortosis were discovered underneath the planet's surface, prompting the [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company]] to take over Apatros. Outer Rim Oreworks established a [[Apatros (colony)|colony]] on the desolate planet and began mining for cortosis, which it sold to the Republic.<ref name="PoD" />

In [[1026 BBY]], a man named [[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the planet, eventually going on to work in the cortosis mines for ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. In [[1003 BBY]], Dessel [[Death/Legends|killed]] a Republic [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] over a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], although with the aid of a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] named [[Groshik]], he was able to escape the planet before being [[Prison/Legends|incarcerated]]. Dessel joined the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Army/Legends|army]] during the [[New Sith Wars]], and, after serving with distinction, his [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] was discovered. He later became [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Bane, one of the most influential [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]].<ref name="PoD" />

==Locations==
Apatros had only one colony on the entire planet, also called Apatros. The Apatros colony was primarily used as the home of the cortosis [[Miner/Legends|miners]] and only had two buildings of note: a [[Groshik's cantina|cantina]] owned by the Neimoidian Groshik, which was the main retreat of off-duty miners and visiting Republic crews, and a [[Outer Rim Oreworks Market|market]], once a barracks, which sold basic items at high prices. The colony and mines were connected by a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] for transport back and forth. The cortosis mines were maintained by the Outer Rim Oreworks Company, but the death toll for miners was high and their equipment outdated and substandard.<ref name="PoD" />

==Inhabitants==
Apatros was mostly inhabited by miners working in the cortosis mines, the majority of which were [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. However, other [[Species/Legends|species]] lived on the planet, including a Neimoidian named Groshik who owned a cantina in the Apatros colony. The most famous of Apatros' inhabitants was Dessel, who worked in the cortosis mines for a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] and later became a Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the Sith after leaving Apatros.<ref name="PoD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Apatros first appeared in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2006]] novel, ''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]'', published as part of his [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']].<ref name="PoD" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Apatros [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Apatros, in grid square Q-16.<ref name="EAOC" />
